affine_initialization.reason: Initial map positions from the labelled half-degree crossings.

seed_provenance: Numbered five-minute rulers on this edition and long continuous interior graticule strokes. Alternating numbered rules and additional interior line observations withheld. Scale-obscured labels omitted.

2.reason: The engraved 31 degree parallel lies about 124 source pixels below the meandering line near Hurreepoor. Its intersection with 77 degrees east was checked on source pixels.

fold_measurement_note: Across the central fold, source columns 7440 through 8150 use the inner engraved edge measured every ten pixels. The strong outer rule locates the matching inner stroke in the striped band. The full original and marked edge were retained for comparison.
crop_review_note: Zero inward offset at the measured inner frame. Native corners and all four sides checked. The southern edge follows the visible bend at the central fold.
